newsitem.title: USA: General Instrument acquires ITT unit.
newsitem.headline: General Instrument acquires ITT unit.

text.p: General Instrument Corp on Tuesday said its Power Semiconductor Division has agreed to acquire the discrete semiconductor business of ITT Industries Inc for about $8 million.

ITT's discrete semiconductor business, based in Freiburg, Germany and Colmar, France, manufactures small signal transistors and zeners, devices that are complementary components to General Semiconductor's existing end use customers.

The acquisition will enable General Semiconductor to address more than 45 percent of the $13 billion worldwide discrete semiconductor market, versus the 15 percent it currently serves, the company said in a press release.
Greneral Instrument's Power Semiconductor Division will become General Semiconductor Inc, a publically traded company, following the restructuring of General Instrument later this summer.
